description: KYC details before configureOnramp. Both platforms have a KYC mapper; the call itself resolves the not-configured error first.

platformOnly.kycInfo.birthCountry: iOS KycInfo.birthCountry is a String. Android stores a CountryCode, asserted at kycInfo.birthCountry.value.
platformOnly.kycInfo.nationalities: iOS KycInfo.nationalities is a string list. Android stores CountryCode values, asserted at kycInfo.nationalities.N.value.
platformOnly.kycInfo.birthCountry.value: Android CountryCode.value. iOS asserts the same country at kycInfo.birthCountry.
platformOnly.kycInfo.nationalities.0.value: Android CountryCode.value. iOS asserts the same list at kycInfo.nationalities.
platformOnly.kycInfo.nationalities.1.value: Android CountryCode.value. iOS asserts the same list at kycInfo.nationalities.
